Needs changes before merge.

The Manual group uses the existing form helpers. The marks read the page draft. The new guards correct finding 1 from PR #1760: marks hide when Properties is closed, hidden, or shows another target. All six Slot tests pass.

This PR changes UI display only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or machining geometry. No golden files changed. Safety-tier mutation checks were not required and were not run.

Local results against upstream/main at 2f6de7c5b0eb7eb9053ce086a8e4705fc0776a78:
- The trial merge was clean. The PR head already contains this main commit.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `xvfb-run -a cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed, 0 failed. UI tests ran from crates/ui.
- UI library: 821 passed, 6 ignored. Integration suites: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, feedback 6, fixtures 7, gpu_render 11 (1 ignored), machine 6, models 4, operations 31, shell 21, sinker_setup 2, theme_files 14. Total: 932 passed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/slot_manual_viz.rs:63`: Transform the draft points through the Slot's draft tilt before projection. This function returns raw X/Y and resolved Z as world coordinates and ignores `tilt`. Generation uses these X/Y values in the local cutting plane, subtracts the frame origin Z from the resolved height, then transforms the path to world space (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:215`, `:1740`, `:3186`). For A angle 90 degrees, B angle 0, origin (0, 0, 0), fixed Top Z 10, and endpoint A (-20, 0), the world point is approximately (-20, -10, 0). The new mark appears at (-20, 0, 10). Use the same frame and height rules for the preview, and add a test for a tilted Slot and a nonzero frame origin. This finding was confirmed by code inspection; it was not exercised by a new runtime test.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:54` / PR body: Add before and after screenshot links for the Manual section and viewport marks. The body lists files on the author's machine, but contains no images or image links. This does not meet issue #1732 or finding 2 from PR #1760. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from this PR body. Do not add them to the PR branch or snapshot goldens.

Nonblocking note: shell.rs grows to 1036 lines and state.rs to 4511 lines. Move display code into a smaller module when this area is next changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both findings from the latest review.

1. Draft A/B marks now use the draft tilt frame. Resolved Top Z is shifted by the frame origin Z before the points map to world space. Pins: `tilted_draft_marks_use_the_cutting_plane` and `tilted_draft_marks_shift_resolved_height_before_the_world_transform`. Both check world points and projected endpoints. Reverting the fix made both tests fail. Restoring it made both pass.
2. The PR body now links before and after images for the Manual section and viewport marks. The four images live only on the fork’s `pr-screenshots` branch at `fddb41b69238be94f03d1e4514cddc5409583262`. The temporary screenshot-link check failed on the old body and passed on the published body. All four links return the inspected PNG bytes. No images or review evidence were committed to this PR branch.

New head: `6059052432390ee622fb09ed41b4d1502caa30bc`.

Validation: `xvfb-run -a cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (934 passed, 7 ignored, 0 failed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 6059052432390ee622fb09ed41b4d1502caa30bc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Both findings from the previous review are resolved:
- The draft points use the draft tilt frame. The code subtracts the frame origin Z from the resolved height before it transforms the points. Both new tests pass. They check world points and projected endpoints at zero and nonzero frame origins.
- The PR body has four working before and after image links. I inspected each image. They show the Manual section and the viewport line. The images are linked from the fork's image commit; this PR adds no images or snapshot goldens.

The marks read the draft without changing the saved operation. The visibility checks hide them when Properties is closed, hidden, or shows another target. The Manual section uses the existing form helpers.

Local results with upstream/main at 17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425:
- Trial merge: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- Gate dry run: passed. Its merge-base also selected unrelated changes from main. I ran the selected UI suites directly under `xvfb-run -a`, from `crates/ui`.
- UI library: 832 passed, 6 ignored. All eight `slot_manual_tests` passed.
- Integration suites: boundary 3; boundary_picks 6; feedback 6; fixtures 7; gpu_render 11, 1 ignored; machine 6; models 4; operations 31; shell 21; sinker_setup 2; theme_files 14; waterjet_tool 1.
- Total: 944 passed, 7 ignored, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- All checks ran locally in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

This PR changes UI display only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or machining geometry. No golden files changed. Safety-tier mutation checks were not required. I did not run mutations.

Requested before merge: none.

Nonblocking note: shell.rs and state.rs remain above the 400-line guideline and grow in this PR. Move display code to a smaller module when this area next changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
